title: Modifier
description: A single modifier definition that can roll on item instances. See Item Instancing and Item and NPC levels in the vault.

mod_id.title: Mod ID
mod_id.description: Stable identifier referenced in rolled item instances. Use snake_case. Never rename — change cascades through every existing rolled item.

name.title: Display name
name.description: Player-facing name shown in item descriptions on rolled items (e.g. 'Burning', 'Of Fire'). Separate from mod_id so designers can rename for clarity without breaking existing rolled instances.

target.title: Stat target
target.description: Which EffectiveStats field this mod feeds.

x-aio-options.label: STR
x-aio-options.description: Strength stat (flat int). Drives melee damage, carry weight.

x-aio-options.label: INT
x-aio-options.description: Intelligence stat (flat int). Drives spell damage.

x-aio-options.label: WIS
x-aio-options.description: Wisdom stat (flat int). Drives healing and TP pool.

x-aio-options.label: AGI
x-aio-options.description: Agility stat (flat int). Drives accuracy and evasion.

x-aio-options.label: CON
x-aio-options.description: Constitution stat (flat int). Drives max HP and armor.

x-aio-options.label: CHA
x-aio-options.description: Charisma stat (flat int). Drives shop prices, dialogue, future faction interactions.

x-aio-options.label: Max HP
x-aio-options.description: Maximum hit points (flat int). Direct survivability.

x-aio-options.label: Max TP
x-aio-options.description: Maximum mana pool for spells (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: Max SP
x-aio-options.description: Maximum stamina pool (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: HP regen
x-aio-options.description: Per-tick HP recovery on top of the base regen formula (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: TP regen
x-aio-options.description: Per-tick TP recovery on top of the base regen formula (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: SP regen
x-aio-options.description: Per-tick SP recovery on top of the base regen formula (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on all outgoing damage. percent_additive sums with other mods on this target; percent_multiplicative compounds.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming damage. Use NEGATIVE percent_additive values for damage reduction (e.g. -0.10 = 10% less damage taken).

x-aio-options.label: Accuracy
x-aio-options.description: Hit-rate input on the combat formula (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: Evasion
x-aio-options.description: Hit-rate input on the combat formula, defender side (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: Armor
x-aio-options.description: Damage-reduction input on the combat formula (flat int).

x-aio-options.label: Crit chance
x-aio-options.description: Probability of a critical hit. Starts at 0.0. percent_additive 0.05 = +5% crit chance.

x-aio-options.label: Crit damage (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on critical-hit damage. Starts at 1.0. percent_additive 0.50 = +50% crit damage.

x-aio-options.label: Crit damage taken (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming crit damage. NEGATIVE values reduce — e.g. -0.10 = 10% less crit damage taken.

x-aio-options.label: Crit resistance
x-aio-options.description: Reduces the chance of being critically hit. Starts at 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Attack speed (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on attack rate. Starts at 1.0. positive percent_additive = faster attacks.

x-aio-options.label: Move speed (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on movement rate. Starts at 1.0.

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt: fire (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on outgoing fire-element damage.

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt: water (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on outgoing water-element damage.

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt: earth (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on outgoing earth-element damage.

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt: wind (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on outgoing wind-element damage.

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt: light (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on outgoing light-element damage.

x-aio-options.label: Damage dealt: dark (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on outgoing dark-element damage.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken: fire (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming fire-element damage. NEGATIVE = fire resistance.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken: water (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming water-element damage. NEGATIVE = water resistance.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken: earth (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming earth-element damage. NEGATIVE = earth resistance.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken: wind (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming wind-element damage. NEGATIVE = wind resistance.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken: light (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming light-element damage. NEGATIVE = light resistance.

x-aio-options.label: Damage taken: dark (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming dark-element damage. NEGATIVE = dark resistance.

x-aio-options.label: Healing dealt (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on the caster's outgoing heals (heal spells, life-steal effects on hit). Starts at 1.0.

x-aio-options.label: Healing received (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on incoming heals applied to this character. Starts at 1.0.

x-aio-options.label: XP gain (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on XP awarded for kills. Typically authored with level_scaling: 0.0 (qualitative, doesn't spiral with item level).

x-aio-options.label: Gold gain (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on gold drops from NPC kills. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Rep gain (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on reputation grants from NPC kills. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Drop chance (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on the d64000 drop roll's effective rate. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Magic find (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier biasing rolled items toward higher rarity tiers. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Slow resistance
x-aio-options.description: Chance to resist incoming slow effects. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Poison resistance
x-aio-options.description: Chance to resist incoming poison effects. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Root resistance
x-aio-options.description: Chance to resist incoming root effects. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Status duration on self (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on status effect duration when applied to this character (buffs and debuffs both). Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Status duration dealt (×)
x-aio-options.description: Multiplier on status effect duration applied to your targets. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Cooldown reduction
x-aio-options.description: Percent reduction on skill/spell cooldowns. percent_additive 0.10 = 10% shorter cooldowns. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

x-aio-options.label: Mana cost reduction
x-aio-options.description: Percent reduction on TP cost per cast. percent_additive 0.10 = 10% cheaper spells. Typically level_scaling: 0.0.

kind.title: Stacking bucket
kind.description: Effect engine stacking bucket. Flat adds to the base; percent-additive sums with other additive mods; percent-multiplicative compounds with other multiplicative mods.

x-aio-options.label: Flat (adds to base)
x-aio-options.description: Adds the rolled value directly to the base stat. Use for integer stats like STR, accuracy, armor, regen ticks.

x-aio-options.label: Percent (additive — sums with other %add)
x-aio-options.description: Goes into the same bucket as other additive percent mods on the same target. The bucket sum is applied as (1 + Σ values) once. Use for the everyday damage-dealt / crit-chance / movement-speed mods.

x-aio-options.label: Percent (multiplicative — compounds)
x-aio-options.description: Each multiplicative mod compounds separately: ∏ (1 + value). Two +30% mods give 1.69×, not 1.60×. Use sparingly — typically for legendary mods or spec-tree bonuses that should feel exceptional.

low.title: Roll low
low.description: Low end of the value range at item level 1 with level_scaling 1.0. Scaled at roll time by level_curve(item.level) × level_scaling.

high.title: Roll high
high.description: High end of the same range. Must be ≥ low.

level_scaling.title: Level scaling factor
level_scaling.description: How strongly the roll range scales with item level. 1.0 = normal. 0.0 = doesn't scale (use for qualitative mods). 2.0 = steep (very impactful at high level).

tier_eligibility.title: Eligible rarity tiers
tier_eligibility.description: Which item rarities can roll this mod. At least one required.

when.title: Optional condition (raw JSON)
when.description: Effect-engine Condition that gates when this mod's bonus applies. Leave absent if unused — saving an empty {} object here will cause the server to reject the modifier on next reload. Hand-edit JSON for valid Conditions until the discriminated-union form lands. Example: {"type":"self_hp_below_pct","pct":30}
